info.title: Eloquent Logic Agent
info.description: logic_agent is a single-threaded JSON-RPC 2.0 server (logic_agent/agent.cpp) that reads Request objects one at a time from STDIN and writes Response objects to STDOUT, one JSON value per line (no HTTP/WebSocket transport), until either STDIN reaches EOF or a "shutdown" call is dispatched (the server sends that call's Response, then exits its request loop without reading any further Requests). While handling a request, it also writes zero or more JSON-RPC Notification objects to STDOUT *before* the final Response — one per liblogic listener callback fired along the way (lexing, parsing, transforming, SAT solving, ...). Those notifications are not part of this document: see feedback-events.schema.json for their method names and payload shapes. A malformed Request (invalid JSON, not an object, missing/wrong "jsonrpc", missing "method") is rejected before dispatch with error -32700 (Parse error) or -32600 (Invalid Request); an unrecognised "method" is rejected with -32601 (Method not found). Both are request-parsing-stage errors that apply uniformly to every method, so they are documented under components.errors but not repeated in each method's own errors list.

methods.name: parse
methods.summary: Lex and parse a formula into an AST.
methods.description: Lexes `formula` and parses it into a syntax tree (logic_agent/rpc/methods/parse_method.cpp), streaming every lexer/parser callback as a notification along the way (see feedback-events.schema.json, categories lexer/*, parser/* or parser/strict/* depending on `strict`). Throws lexer_exception/unknown_variable_error (reported as -32000 Server error) on malformed input.

formula.description: The propositional-logic formula to lex and parse.

strict.description: When true, use the cursor-based strict_parser (requires fully parenthesized input, e.g. "(A \\wedge B)") instead of the default Pratt-style relaxed_parser.

tree.description: The parsed AST's root, or null if the formula parsed to no root.

methods.name: transform
methods.summary: Parse a formula and rewrite it to NNF, CNF, or DNF.
methods.description: Parses `formula` (identical first stage to `parse`) then runs eloquent::logic::transformation_runner to rewrite the AST to the requested normal form, streaming every parser and transformation-rule callback as a notification (categories lexer/*, parser/*|parser/strict/*, transform/* — see feedback-events.schema.json). (logic_agent/rpc/methods/transform_method.cpp)

formula.description: The propositional-logic formula to parse and transform.

strict.description: When true, use strict_parser instead of the default relaxed_parser.

target.description: The normal form to rewrite the parsed AST into.

tree.description: The rewritten AST's root, or null if the formula parsed to no root.

methods.name: sat
methods.summary: Parse a formula, convert it to CNF, and decide satisfiability.
methods.description: Parses `formula`, always converts it to CNF first (regardless of `target`, which the `transform` method offers independently), maps it to a DIMACS-style clause set (streamed under mapper/*), then runs the requested SAT algorithm over the clause set (streamed under sat/*). (logic_agent/rpc/methods/sat_method.cpp)

formula.description: The propositional-logic formula to check for satisfiability.

strict.description: When true, use strict_parser instead of the default relaxed_parser.

algorithm.description: The SAT algorithm to run: Davis-Putnam (dp), DPLL with the MOM's/Jeroslow-Wang-style branching heuristic (dpll_mcl), randomized DPLL (dpll_rand), or first-fit resolution (resolution).

mapping.description: Atom name -> its positive DIMACS literal id.

clauses.description: The CNF clause set as DIMACS-style clauses: each clause is an array of nonzero literal ids (negative = negated atom).

methods.name: logical_consequence
methods.summary: Parse a \models formula and decide whether the entailment holds.
methods.description: Parses `formula`, which must have "\\models" as its single top-level operator (splitting it into Premises \models Conclusion), then decides the entailment by rewriting it to Premises & ~Conclusion and checking that for unsatisfiability (streamed under transform/*, mapper/*, sat/* like the `sat` method, plus logical_consequence/* for the entailment-level callbacks themselves). UNSAT means the entailment holds. Throws incompatible_top_level_operator (reported as -32000 Server error) if `formula`'s top-level operator isn't "\\models". (logic_agent/rpc/methods/logical_consequence_method.cpp)

formula.description: A formula with "\\models" as its single top-level operator, e.g. "A \\wedge (A \\implies B) \\models B".

strict.description: When true, use strict_parser instead of the default relaxed_parser.

result.description: true iff Premises \models Conclusion holds, i.e. Premises & ~Conclusion is unsatisfiable.

methods.name: truth_table
methods.summary: Parse a formula and compute its full truth table.
methods.description: Parses `formula` then evaluates it under every assignment of its variables, streaming every parser and truth-table-evaluation callback as a notification (categories lexer/*, parser/*|parser/strict/*, truth_table/* — see feedback-events.schema.json). (logic_agent/rpc/methods/truth_table_method.cpp)

strict.description: When true, use strict_parser instead of the default relaxed_parser.

headers.description: The formula's variable names in column order, followed by the formula text itself as the last (result) column header.

rows.description: One row per variable assignment: one boolean per variable (in `headers` order) plus a trailing boolean for the whole formula's value under that assignment.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Tells logic_agent to exit its request loop after sending this method's Response — no further Requests are read from STDIN once the process has replied. Takes no params and streams no notifications. (logic_agent/rpc/methods/shutdown_method.cpp)

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: JSON-serializable mirror of CppCommon::UUID (logic_agent/types/core/uuid_t.hpp): a bare string in canonical "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx" form, not a subobject.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: Mirrors eloquent::logic::Node (src/parser/node.h) via logic_agent/types/core/node_t.hpp. A plain value type: no parent pointer, and children are referenced by uuid (each child's own Node, if needed, is reachable the same way this node was) rather than embedded recursively.

ParseError.data: Invalid JSON was received by the server (nlohmann::json::parse_error while reading a Request line). Request-parsing-stage error, occurs before any method is dispatched.

InvalidRequest.data: The received JSON is not a valid Request object: not a JSON object, "jsonrpc" missing or not "2.0", or "method" missing or not a string (logic_agent/types/rpc_request.cpp). Request-parsing-stage error, occurs before any method is dispatched.

MethodNotFound.data: "method" is not one of parse, transform, sat, logical_consequence, truth_table, shutdown (logic_agent/rpc/dispatcher.cpp).

InvalidParams.data: "params" is missing a required field, a field has the wrong type, or an enum field (target/algorithm) has an unrecognised value.

InternalError.data: Reserved for JSON-RPC-internal errors; currently unused by any handler in this codebase.

ServerError.data: Catch-all for any std::exception raised by liblogic itself while handling the request (lexer_exception, unknown_variable_error, unbound_variable_error, unsupported_operator_error, ...) that isn't already an rpc_exception (agent.cpp).
